mapper.sql: r.id, r.batch_id, r.student_id, r.major, r.class_name, r.grade, r.score_a, r.c_score, r.mu, r.score_b, r.score_m, r.rank_in_major, r.rank_in_grade_major, r.total_in_major, r.award_tier, r.qualified, r.created_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, RIGHT(COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id), 4) AS student_no_tail, CASE r.award_tier WHEN 't1' THEN '一等奖学金' WHEN 't2' THEN '二等奖学金' WHEN 't3' THEN '三等奖学金' ELSE NULL END AS award_tier_text
FROM rank_row r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = r.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO rank_row (batch_id, student_id, major, class_name, grade, score_a, c_score, mu, score_b, score_m, rank_in_major, rank_in_grade_major, total_in_major, award_tier, qualified, created_at) VALUES
(#{row.batchId}, #{row.studentId}, #{row.major}, #{row.className}, #{row.grade}, #{row.scoreA}, #{row.cScore}, #{row.mu}, #{row.scoreB}, #{row.scoreM}, #{row.rankInMajor}, #{row.rankInGradeMajor}, #{row.totalInMajor}, #{row.awardTier}, #{row.qualified}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.major AS major, r.grade AS grade, COUNT(*) AS ranked, SUM(CASE WHEN r.award_tier = 't1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tier1, SUM(CASE WHEN r.award_tier = 't2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tier2, SUM(CASE WHEN r.award_tier = 't3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tier3, SUM(CASE WHEN r.qualified = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qualified FROM rank_row r WHERE r.batch_id = #{batchId} GROUP BY r.major, r.grade ORDER BY r.major, r.grade
